fix.name: withdraw_pays_at_most_amount
fix.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and pre("ETH", A0) - post("ETH", A0) > pre("totalLocked") - post("totalLocked")
fix.why: ETH paid out never exceeds the booked decrease; comparing with a single deposit's amount false-alarms when the U1 callback legitimately withdraws a second deposit it owns

add.name: withdraw_pays_owner_exact
add.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender == U0 and post("ETH", sender) - pre("ETH", sender) != pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount")
add.why: a withdrawing (non-callback) owner receives exactly the deposit amount

add.name: owner_changes_only_via_move
add.expr: ok and not called("moveOwnership") and pre("deposits", arg(0), "owner") != 0 and post("deposits", arg(0), "owner") != pre("deposits", arg(0), "owner")
add.why: an existing deposit's owner changes only through moveOwnership
